lines.369680623648452611: I know the words to all of his songs.
lines.369680623652646912: It'll be the kind of moment that lasts forever.
lines.369680623652646913: I guess you’re his biggest fan.
lines.369680623656841217: But I know him better than he knows himself.
lines.369680623656841218: The show is about to start.
lines.369680623656841219: I wouldn't want to miss this for the world.
lines.369680623665229824: The cable car won't run without the bells.
lines.369680623665229826: It won't run without the bells.
lines.369680623669424128: What do you mean? It's not working?
lines.369680623669424129: It's working just fine. It just won't run without the bells.
lines.369680623673618432: It's my job, you know. I make sure it runs just fine. But not without the bells.
lines.369680623673618433: What happened to the bells then?
lines.369680623673618434: Someone's always messing with them. Maybe someone who doesn't want you to see what's up on that peak.
lines.369680623673618435: I'm looking for Eddie Velvet. Is here up there?
lines.369680623677812736: I couldn't say. Wouldn't surprise me, he's been there before. He and his lady friend.
lines.369680623677812738: I shouldn't say anything more, not with everything that happened. It's with the sheriff now, that's all I know. They'll sort it out.
lines.369680623682007040: Haven't I seen you before? That bar, the Rabbit Hole?
lines.369680623682007041: I loved to watch Eddie play. Music is what makes life worth living, don't you think?
lines.369680623686201344: Until you've found the bells, the cable car won't run.
lines.369680623686201345: This is the only way to get up to the peak.
lines.369680623690395648: They killed him so he'd forget.
lines.369680623694589952: His name. His size. His shape. Everything.
lines.369680623694589953: Hello? They can't seem to hear me.
lines.369680623698784256: Picked away at him, piece by piece. With enough gone, he lost himself.
lines.369680623698784257: Nothing left but an empty shell.
lines.369680623702978560: What am I doing here? What’s going on? I can’t make any sense of this place…
lines.369680623707172865: Her name is Alice. Eddie thought he could win her over, get her to turn her back on everything she knew and loved. But it wasn’t that easy.
lines.369680623707172867: Didn’t mean to startle you. Just thought you might want a helping hand.
lines.369680623707172869: A sweetheart. The toast of the town. An angel, if you ask me.
lines.369680623715561473: Well, she did have another side to her. But it only made her more beautiful.
lines.369680623715561474: Sounds like you loved her. Did Eddie kill her?
lines.369680623715561475: When you find him you can ask him that yourself. Ask him what gave him the right to come here and pull her away from us.
lines.369680623715561476: Ask him if it was worth it.
